component.name: FaderFrame
component.summary: Record, edit, mix and master multitrack audio and MIDI

description.p: FaderFrame is a digital audio workstation for recording, editing, mixing and mastering. It routes audio through a realtime graph with buses, aux sends, sidechains, groups and VCAs, processes it on all cores with automatic plugin delay compensation, and hosts CLAP and VST3 plugins.

ul.li: Arranger with Pro Tools style edit modes, take comping, warping and fades
Analogue console style mixer with inserts, sends and metering
Piano roll, MIDI recording, MPE, MIDI clock and MTC sync
Automation with Touch, Latch and Write modes
Mastering tools: EBU R128 loudness, true peak, phase and spectrum
Native PipeWire and JACK on Linux
Skins from dark studio consoles to a light theme
